test_cases.input: Explain the difference between synchronous and asynchronous database drivers in Python.
test_cases.actual_output: Synchronous drivers block the event loop while waiting for database queries to complete, whereas asynchronous drivers yield execution during I/O operations, allowing concurrent request processing.
test_cases.expected_output: Async drivers do not block the thread during I/O operations, enabling high-concurrency throughput compared to blocking sync drivers.
